name: bank-statement-categorizer
description: Categorise bank, card and payment-app statement exports (.csv/.xlsx, Chinese or English) with keyword rules you can edit, fix any transaction by hand, spot uncategorised and double-counted rows, and see totals by category and month. Export a categorised Excel file, CSV and an HTML report; keep your rules for next month. Runs locally; no bank login, no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Categorise bank, card and payment-app statement exports (.csv/.xlsx, Chinese or English) with keyword rules you can edit, fix any transaction by hand, spot uncategorised and double-counted rows, and see totals by category and month. Export a categorised Excel file, CSV and an HTML report; keep your rules for next month. Runs locally; no bank login, no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把银行卡、信用卡、支付软件导出的流水（.csv/.xlsx，中英文都行）按可编辑的关键词规则自动分类，可逐笔手动改分类，标出未分类和可能重复计入的交易，按分类和月份汇总收支。导出分类后的 Excel、CSV 和 HTML 报告，规则可以下个月继续用。在本地运行，不需要登录银行，无需 API 密钥。
